_note: Targets for the headless calibration harness (tools/calibrate). League-wide averages over many simulated seasons. 'tol' is the acceptable band; outside it the harness fails. These targets apply to the neutral engine: tune with all style modifiers at 1.0. Then each league is checked with its own modifiers (competitions_mvp.json) against target x modifier, per leagueChecks below (ENG2 at chanceQuality 0.88 landing ~2.5 goals per match is correct).

leagueChecks._note: Per-league gate, run with each league's styleModifiers. For the metrics listed under a modifier, target and tol are multiplied by that league's modifier value. Other perMatch metrics are reported per league but gated only on the neutral run. directness is an AI-tactics bias, not a metric scale.

topClubStarterMinutesShare.note: share of available minutes for a top club's 11 most-used players

worldStability20Seasons.note: Sanity checks over a 20-season headless run

seniorMeanOvrDrift.note: senior mean OVR, last season vs season 1 (T, 2026-10-19)

elite75ShareDrift.note: share of seniors rated 75+, last season vs season 1 (T, 2026-10-19)

worldStability20Seasons.peakAge: 27-29-year-olds rated at least as high as 21-23 and 24-26-year-olds in the last season (MILESTONES M4)
worldStability20Seasons.playerCountDrift: total active players stays within +/- 10% of start
worldStability20Seasons.differentChampionsENG1: at least 3 distinct champions in 20 seasons
worldStability20Seasons.promotedClubsSurvivalRate: roughly 35-60% of promoted clubs avoid relegation

performanceBudget.simFullMvpSeasonInBrowser: < 60 s on a mid-range laptop, including all season processing
